sources.title: Application of Blockchain Technology in Carbon Trading Market: A Systematic Review
sources.authors: Timileyin P. Abiodun; Nnamdi I. Nwulu; Peter O. Olukanmi
sources.summary: Systematic review (PRISMA; 2015–2023 literature) of blockchain-based carbon trading designs, limitations and future research.
sources.naft_use: Prior-art and threat-model reference for interoperability, scalability, privacy and operational transparency; not evidence of NaFT performance.
sources.gap: Review does not establish validity of any NaFT or national methodology.

sources.title: Global, robust and comparable digital carbon assets
sources.summary: PACT prototype: reproducible project accounting with additionality, leakage and permanence adjustments; registry and token design on Tezos.
sources.naft_use: Prior-art comparison for project-level provenance and comparability; NaFT's methodology-change impact analysis is a different objective.
sources.gap: Paper's project examples and evaluation are not NaFT-validated emission factors or ground-truth observations.

sources.title: Understanding the Blockchain Oracle Problem: A Call for Action
sources.summary: Reviews the blockchain oracle problem: chain immutability cannot authenticate data crossing real-world trust boundaries.
sources.naft_use: Supports design rationale to keep original evidence, measurement quality and external-source verification distinct from Sepolia hash lineage.
sources.gap: Not a carbon-specific validation benchmark or implementation approval.

sources.title: Emission Impossible: privacy-preserving carbon emissions claims
sources.authors: Jessica Man; Sadiq Jaffer; Patrick Ferris; Martin Kleppmann; Anil Madhavapeddy
sources.summary: Proposes zk-SNARK-based verifiable supply-chain/cloud emissions claims without exposing sensitive inputs; example relation CustomerEmissions = Intensity × TotalEnergy × Share.
sources.naft_use: Future privacy-preserving proof research question; NOT evidence of an existing NaFT ZKP circuit, proof system or deployed verifier.
sources.gap: Workshop draft contains placeholder DOI 10.1145/nnnnnnn.nnnnnnn; do not cite that placeholder as a registered DOI.

sources.title: Continuous Improvement Work Program report: Digital Monitoring, Reporting and Verification
sources.authors: The Integrity Council for the Voluntary Carbon Market; CIWP participants
sources.summary: Exploratory CIWP recommendations: digital tool governance, re-approval triggers (section 6.2), transparency, responsibilities, full-data-pipeline uncertainty (6.10) and independent benchmarking.
sources.naft_use: High-priority governance reference for version/change impact and evidence-pipeline documentation, but only as candidate requirements and future evaluation criteria.
sources.gap: Report expressly says recommendations are not ICVCM policy, consensus, certification or a change to CCP Assessment Framework; exact public report URL not verified.
